description: This file is a shell script for creating and appending a Linksys signature footer to a firmware image. It handles temporary directories, input validation, CRC calculation, and appends a structured footer containing version, device type, CRC, signature, and padding to facilitate firmware identification and validation in Linksys devices.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage information and exits for the script.

methods.name: main logic
methods.description: Performs input validation, creates temporary workspace, computes CRC, appends signature footer to the input image.
